source.meaning: Frozen product source for adapter fixtures only; not a balance or release verdict.

scope.game: original solo four-seat finite extensive-form game
scope.eventDecision: One sealed choice per living seat for the current event. Each commitment is private until the original event reveal.
scope.eventReveal: All submitted values, life deltas and public event logs are returned only after the pinned engine settles the full profile.

fixtures.proves: All eight current events enumerate the exact pick values or every integer 0..cap plus an explicit null pass where supported; committed choices cannot be revised.
fixtures.doesNotProve: All other decision phases, full chance support, or exhaustive joint event outcome chance branches.

fixtures.proves: Complete sealed event profiles pass through the frozen engine settleEvent function and expose the same public choice, life-delta and log data that the event reveal shows.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Cross-phase snapshots, complete full-game transitions, or an exhaustive event chance tree.

fixtures.proves: The event-screen projection excludes all sealed choices, market and future-market contents, RNG and opponent bag items. Event recall rejects mixed-seat histories. The subsequent auction projection accepts only same-round public event result fields, strips arbitrary extra fields and rejects stale-round reveals.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Observation equivalence for omitted phases or complete full recall across event and auction histories.

nextEngineeringDeliverable.name: complete remaining player decision phases and cross-phase history
requirements: Enumerate public mark, sacrifice and shrine-pick actions at their true input boundaries.
Carry event reveal data, previous sealed commitments and each seat's own action through a full-recall history without exposing hidden state.
Adapt automatic battle, chance and settlement transitions and compare them with the frozen engine.
Prove complete chance support, cross-night state restoration, canonicalization, terminal/payoff mapping and a feasible solver scope before any pass claim.

gate.blockingReason: Auction and event decisions are partial. Mark, sacrifice, shrine-pick and remaining transitions, chance, cross-night restore, canonicalization, full recall, policy enumeration, terminal/payoff mapping and independent solver review remain incomplete.
